description: Meta keeps one dependency under Renovate: the release build container, pinned by digest (the same image and digest management as Core's release lane).

customManagers.description: The release workflow's build container, pinned by digest inside a job expression that no built-in manager reads.

packageRules.description: The build container builds every Linux release binary: a new digest is proposed a week after its release, in a group of its own, and never automerged.
